Course NOTES - cliff-note compilations of topics covered (more to be added)

  • Unix
  • C Basics includes data types and operators
  • C Input/Output includes file operations & binary files
  • Control Structures
  • C Arrays
  • C Strings
  • C Functions (including make)
  • Storage Classes (including gdb)
  • Pointers & Dynamic Memory Allocation (including valgrind)

  • C Struct types (including enum)

  • C++ Basics
  • C++ Input/Output
  • C++ string class
  • C++ Standard Template Library
  • C++ Dynamic Memory
  • C++ Class Definitions
  • Overloading in C++
  • Function & Class Templates
  • Inheritance & Polymorphism
  • Object Oriented Design (& Teamwork)
  • Error & Exception Handling
  • Lambdas & Miscellany
